name: peer-the-depths-look-four-opponent-banish-one-rest-bottom
notes: Peer the Depths (6JMwc6cpRm): cast from the response window of player 1's recollection phase. The opponent's deck top four (under the filler its turn-2 draw takes) are Dungeon Guide, Fluffy Shopkeep, Fairy Whispers, Charge the Soul: all four are offered; Fairy Whispers (3rd) is banished and the other three go to the bottom of the OPPONENT's deck in the caster's chosen order (Charge the Soul, Fluffy Shopkeep, Dungeon Guide). Pre-fix only the top card was looked at.

rulesClauses: Look at the top four cards of that player's deck and banish a card from among them. Put the rest on the bottom of their deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. PeerTheDepthsResolve() pulled the opponent's top four cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "theirDeck-0", "myTempZone"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "theirDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card of the opponent's deck was ever looked at (live repro on HEAD: the banish prompt offered the single card myTempZone-0). Fixed with the new MZMoveTopOfZone() helper (it flips the zone perspective for $player != the viewer exactly like MZMove).
